issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring a test for every feature and endpoint.
Password reset link is hand-rolled with createToken plus sendPasswordResetNotification instead of reusing Password::sendResetLink.
Auth forms use bare inputs without labels, status or error display and no Blade components, missing the accessible UI test pattern.
Reset form is functional but provides no labels or error/status slots, making it harder to use and maintain.
phpunit.xml pins two extra env vars beyond the three required by the task and out-of-scope rule.
No CHANGELOG or docs update ships with the user-facing auth-mail change.

conventions.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:33-38 hand-rolls Password::broker()->createToken instead of Password::sendResetLink; resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:1-5 bare inputs with no labels/components; no tests and no CHANGELOG

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:79-104 and app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:35-49 small focused methods with clear names; resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:3 bare <input type=email> with no label

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:569-578 all five route names with guest and auth+signed+throttle:6,1; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:84 PasswordRule::min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers() with remember_token rotation and PasswordReset event; lang/pt_BR.json:196,204 both subjects; pegafila.css:493-500 #0f7490 on .button-primary

scope.evidence: All controllers, routes, views, theme and lang entries serve the task; only extra is phpunit.xml:17-20 APP_ENV and APP_MAINTENANCE_DRIVER beyond the three required pins

security.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:39 hash_equals plus abort(403) behind auth+signed+throttle:6,1; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:81-85 validates token/email/password; views use {{ $token }} escaping; always returns passwords.sent without revealing existence

simplicity.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:33-38 duplicates Password::sendResetLink with manual lookup plus createToken; otherwise lean controllers and standard published pegafila.css theme

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or *Test.php; no feature tests for password.request/email/reset/update or verification.verify including failure paths

review.summary: The change implements all password-reset and email-verification routes, controllers, theme and translations correctly with solid security. It is blocked by missing Pest tests and weak auth-form markup, plus hand-rolled reset-link sending instead of reusing the Password broker.
